intro: The most open country in Europe for remote workers. The D7 and Digital Nomad Visa, a mild Atlantic climate, and English spoken in Lisbon and Porto.
climate: Atlantic and Mediterranean — mild rainy winters and warm dry summers. In the south (the Algarve) there is more sunshine than in any other European country.
mentality: A relaxed Southern European pace, friendliness and a culture of calm. A high level of safety.
language_note: Portuguese is the official language and differs from the Brazilian variety. English is spoken everywhere in Lisbon, Porto and the Algarve.
visa_note: Digital Nomad Visa (income from €3,280/month), D7 (passive income from €820/month), Tech Visa (for IT specialists). The NHR tax benefit was replaced by IFICI in 2024.
